scientific.integrity: The unbounded classification is proved from the exact Picard lattice and standard K3 base-point-free/very-ample criteria; the finite script is only a consistency replay of the arithmetic formulas.
scientific.limitations: Classification of complete linear systems on the fixed Picard-\(U\) surface only; no equations for the very-ample embeddings or moduli-level orbit classification are asserted.

title: Base-point-free and very-ample spectra on Festi's Picard-\(U\) K3 surface
